complete_examples.text: The parameters used in the model establishment are listed as follows: (1) The inner diameter of each arc in the tunnel section: R1, R2, R3, R4 (2) The center coordinates of each arc of the tunnel section: zr1, zr2, zr3, zr4, yr1, yr2, yr3, yr4 (3) The total thickness of tunnel lining: D (4) The thickness of each layer of tunnel lining grid: d (5) Longitudinal length of tunnel lining grid: lt (6) Elastic modulus and Poisson’s ratio of tunnel lining: Et and ut (7) Mass density of tunnel lining: ρt (8) Connection stiffness and damping between tunnel segment and surrounding rock mass: kts, cts (9) The angle between the global Y-axis of the tunnel and the tunnel lining grid node: α (10) The number of grid layers of the tunnel grid node: j According to the principle of isoparametric element, the shape functions used in the 8-node isoparametric element can be described as Ni 1⁄4 ð1 þ ξiξÞð1 þ ηiηÞð1 þ ζ iζÞ , i 1⁄4 1, 2, .
